note: Ceilings for the CI perf gate (scripts/perf-budget-check.mjs), checked against the median of 3 runs on a GitHub runner. Calibrated 2026-11-13 (audit R3) without a runner: on Apple Silicon with PERF_CPU_THROTTLE=4 as a pessimistic stand-in, the medians were open 3890 ms, dragPanel 9 long tasks / 867 ms, dragChild 4 / 613 ms, nudge 1768 ms, pan 12, zoom 12; at no throttle they were 1501 ms, 1 / 87, 1 / 90, 0, 0, 1. Each ceiling is about 1.6x the throttled number, and still well under the regression the gate exists for: dragPanel before the drag hot-path work was 38 long tasks / 2585 ms on the laptop, unthrottled. The old ceilings failed at PERF_CPU_THROTTLE=3 (nudge 1302 ms > 1200) and sat at the edge for pan and zoom (7 and 8 of 8). Tighten from the perf-large-report artifact of real runner runs, not from a laptop.
